correctness.rationale: For \(k<n\) and non-scalar symmetric \(A\), a Haar-random kernel is almost surely noninvariant. Choosing \(w\in\ker S\) with \(x=PAw\ne0\) gives the exact identity \(r_S(w+tx)=\|x\|^2/(t x^{\mathsf T}Px)+(x^{\mathsf T}PAx)/(x^{\mathsf T}Px)\), which proves every real value. For \(n=2\), \(k\ge2\), the symmetric numerator is indefinite exactly when the squared Gaussian-column correlation exceeds \(4mM/(m+M)^2\); the correlation follows the \(\operatorname{Beta}(1/2,(k-1)/2)\) law. Endpoint beta integration gives the sharp large-\(k\) constant. The embedded checker completed 11,209 tests; no finite experiment substitutes for the almost-sure or asymptotic proof.

limitations: Real Gaussian sketched one-vector coefficient only; post-sketch choice of start; exact probability in the injective case established only for \(n=2\) and \(k\ge2\); finite precision and similarity-restored algorithms outside scope.

originality.rationale: The quantifier-swapped uniform-start event is mathematically different from the fixed-predetermined-start conditional law. Three relevant primary full texts explain sketched Ritz instability, corrections, and fixed-subspace embedding, but do not provide the complete real-surjectivity statement for every undersampled non-scalar SPD operator or the exact two-mode existential positivity probability. The sample-correlation beta identity itself is classical and is not claimed as new; combining it with a global generalized-Rayleigh sign certificate yields the stated numerical reliability classification. Indexed record searches found no implication-level covering claim; an unindexed equivalent elementary matrix-pencil calculation remains a genuine residual priority risk.

value.rationale: An all-start sign safety property is a natural uniform numerical-algorithm reliability question which does not follow from prescribed-start embedding or fixed-start probability analysis. The complete rank obstruction explains that reducing sketch rows below dimension can destroy every finite range bound, while the two-mode exact beta tail quantifies how adding rows restores uniform positivity with sharp sample-size exponential rate. Such distinctions are useful for specifying sketch-reuse or adversarial-start safeguards; no assertion about practical fixed-start algorithm failure or higher-dimension exact probability is made.
